Keep Web's `IntersectionObserverModule` compatible with the six methods consumed by `@lynx-js/lynx-core`: `createIntersectionObserver`, `relativeTo`, `relativeToViewport`, `relativeToScreen`, `observe`, and `disconnect`. DOM observation belongs to the main thread and must remain scoped to one `LynxViewInstance`; the background native module should only send commands and dispatch resulting payloads through `tt.onIntersectionObserverEvent`. Delay browser `IntersectionObserver` construction until the first target is observed so root, margin, and threshold options are final. Keep the original thresholds as the Lynx semantic source of truth, but add a small browser-only threshold above each value below 1 so leaving an exact threshold upward still produces an entry in Chromium and WebKit. Preserve Lynx payload fields and coordinates: viewport and element-root results are LynxView-relative, screen results use browser viewport coordinates, and disconnected or disposed observers must not emit callbacks.
